title: Pay or leave
body: Any basic feature like repeat events and import your current calendar is behind a paywall. Looks a great app, but you can’t even do the basics without subscription.
author: clineuiansen

title: Works great for me as an autistic person!
body: I’ve tried several (paid) visual planning apps, and Structured is by far the best I’ve tried. Setting up tasks is easy, especially as the app remembers previous tasks. Planning the week on Structured feels like a self care step rather than another executive functioning task. The visual timers are simple and exactly what I need and Apple Watch integration is seamless. The energy tracking feature is a great addition I haven’t seen in other apps. I appreciate that while the app does have AI integration it is easily disabled and doesn’t impact functionality. As someone who needs a strong visual planner as a daily disability aid, I find Structured to be intuitive, calming, and amazing value for money.

title: Great aesthetic and features
body: Only had the app very briefly but for my use of ADHD management and keeping on top of daily tasks that I would otherwise forget, it’s fantastic. I would LOVE it if I could set up yearly tasks so that I can more easily remember birthdays which is one of the main draws to apps like these. I’m instituting a way around it by adding a note to recreate the task, but this could very easily be fixed within the app itself. Currently the longest duration for a repeating task is monthly.

title: Looks nice, but not too useful
body:
This app is decent if you are able to strictly adhere to your envisioned schedule and not deviate from it. Should something get in the way of you working on your current task, it’s a pain to have to shift the whole day forward manually and adds extra friction to the UX. Not having past unfinished tasks displayed in the widget is also not great, as it kind of implies those tasks are no longer relevant and therefore need not to be displayed.

However, I do want to give it some stars for looking pretty sleek, and having repeat tasks and reminders pretty customizable.

After one year of usage (my Pro just expired), I just cancelled and am switching to Super Prod instead.
